about: Source of truth for the client reviews on the site. tools/build_reviews.py reads this file and writes the review blocks into the pages. Quote text is final display text: 'Consultus Digital' in full, no em dashes, apostrophes as the typographic character. People whose quote is not cleared yet are NOT in this file on purpose (the repository is public); add them here only when they are cleared. Source of the quotes: Jake's kit (Drive: Website Testimonials, quotes.csv, Oct 9 2026) and the pages as they were on Oct 12 2026.
